identitySignals.signal: You need AI to take useful action but still need to know what happened, why and whether it was verified.
identitySignals.evidenceRequirement: A public or internal workflow must show durable state, approval boundaries and independent verification.

identitySignals.signal: Your product is live enough to matter, but technical friction is slowing delivery or trust.
identitySignals.evidenceRequirement: A current, attributable blocker must be recorded before any outreach claim.

identitySignals.signal: Your coding-agent workflow produces changes, but the evidence and handoff are inconsistent.
identitySignals.evidenceRequirement: Repository-safe audit output and repeatable validation evidence must exist.

identitySignals.signal: People can find your business, but the website does not make the next useful action obvious.
identitySignals.evidenceRequirement: A visible journey, performance, accessibility or conversion issue must be demonstrable.

identitySignals.signal: You are manually comparing fragmented county records and need every research decision to retain its source.
identitySignals.evidenceRequirement: The current product evidence must demonstrate source-bound, repeatable property research without any return claim.

problemsOutcomes.problem: AI workflows can appear successful without durable evidence or independent readback.
problemsOutcomes.outcome: A governed workflow that fails closed and proves external outcomes before reporting success.

problemsOutcomes.problem: A founder has a real product or business but lacks evidence-led technical diagnosis.
problemsOutcomes.outcome: A small number of demonstrable, commercially relevant technical priorities.

problemsOutcomes.problem: Coding-agent work is difficult to trust when discovery, validation and handoff are not reproducible.
problemsOutcomes.outcome: Read-only evidence packs that make repository decisions inspectable.

problemsOutcomes.problem: A website makes the visitor work too hard to understand the offer or take the next step.
problemsOutcomes.outcome: A clearer, faster and more accessible route to a useful enquiry.

problemsOutcomes.problem: Research-heavy product workflows become unreliable when provenance and decisions are separated.
problemsOutcomes.outcome: A product workflow that keeps evidence attached to each decision.

problemsOutcomes.problem: Social automation can duplicate, truncate or falsely report a provider write.
problemsOutcomes.outcome: Exactly-once, API-only publication with transactional recovery and provider readback.
